components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default action — ink fill, peach label. Used for Catat transaksi and form submit.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #1C1917; color: #FFCC99; padding: 14px 18px; font-family: Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); width: 100%; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #44403C; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #57534E; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #1C1917; }

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: Inverted polarity — peach fill, ink label. Used inside balance hero card.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-accent"><svg class="ds-icon" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"><line x1="12" y1="5" x2="12" y2="19"/><line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12"/></svg> Tambah catatan</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #FFCC99; color: #1C1917; padding: 14px 18px; font-family: Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); width: 100%; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background: #FFD4A8; } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #57534E; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-icon { flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat content container — white fill, soft border, zero elevation.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.13); border-radius: 14px; padding: 14px 16px; } .ds-card-label { font-family: Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #44403C; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-card-body { font-family: Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #1C1917; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Filled form field with soft border and focus ring via border shift.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-field-label { font-family: Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; color: #1C1917; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-input { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.13); border-radius: 14px; padding: 14px 16px; font-family: Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #1C1917; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s; } .ds-input:focus { border: 1.5px solid #57534E; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #57534E; }

components.name: Bottom Navigation
components.description: Four-tab mobile nav — peach indicator, ink selected, muted unselected.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; justify-content: space-around; align-items: center; height: 60px; background: #FFFFFF; border-top: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08); } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 2px; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 14px; color: #57534E; font-family: Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; transition: color 0.2s, background 0.2s; } .ds-nav-item--active { color: #1C1917; background: rgba(255,204,153,0.65); } .ds-nav-item:hover:not(.ds-nav-item--active) { color: #44403C; }

components.name: Type Toggle
components.description: Income/expense selector in transaction form — semantic green/red fills.
components.css: .ds-type-toggle { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-type-btn { flex: 1; padding: 14px; font-family: Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; border: none; border-radius: 16px; cursor: pointer; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); color: #1C1917; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-type-btn--selected.ds-type-btn--income { background: #15803D; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-type-btn--selected.ds-type-btn--expense { background: #B91C1C; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-type-btn:hover:not(.ds-type-btn--selected) { background: #ECE8E3; }

narrative.overview: UangKy should feel like a competent pocket notebook you trust with real money — not a gamified app, not a corporate bank portal, not a SaaS dashboard. The interface disappears into the task: log a transaction, check a balance, scan a chart, move on. Visual personality is sharp and minimal; warmth arrives through the peach accent on deliberate moments (primary actions, nav selection, brand logo), never through decorative scaffolding.
keyCharacteristics: Numbers-first — balances and amounts use the heaviest type weights
Ink + peach pairing — dark ink structures the UI; peach accents selection and brand
Tonal flatness — depth via surface steps, not shadow stacks
Tactile confidence — filled buttons, 14–16px corners, w700–w800 headings
Material 3 native — system sans, standard navigation and form patterns

rules.name: The Peach Accent Rule
rules.body: Peach appears on primary button labels (on ink), nav indicators, balance figures on dark panels, and brand moments. It is forbidden as a page background, gradient wash, or card fill.

rules.name: The One Ink Voice Rule
rules.body: Ledger Ink (#1C1917) is the single dark structural color. Do not introduce navy, charcoal gradients, or secondary dark hues.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Size Rule
rules.body: Emphasis on numbers and headings comes from font weight (w700–w800), not oversized display type. Balance hero maxes at 26px; page titles stay at titleLarge.

rules.name: The System Sans Rule
rules.body: No custom font imports. Roboto / SF Pro / system-ui only. Display fonts in labels or data are prohibited.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Cards, inputs, and list rows are flat at rest. elevation: 0 everywhere. Depth = surface color step + 1px border.

rules.name: The No-Gradient-Scaffold Rule
rules.body: The shell's peach-to-muted gradient wrapper is a known exception. New screens should not add decorative background gradients; the scaffold color alone is sufficient.

dos: Do use Ledger Ink (#1C1917) for primary actions and structural panels; peach only for accent labels, indicators, and brand moments.
Do set elevation: 0 on all cards and rely on surface color steps + 1px borders for depth.
Do render currency amounts at w700–w800; the number is the hero, not the container around it.
Do pair income/expense colors with text labels for color-blind accessibility.
Do keep corner radius consistent at 14px (16px for hero panels and type toggles only).
Do use the full-width Catat transaksi button above the nav bar — never a floating FAB.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: crossfade or instant state changes.
donts: Don't use generic SaaS finance dashboard patterns: cream/sand body backgrounds, hero-metric cards, gradient accents, eyebrow kickers, identical icon-card grids.
Don't gamify the UI — no coins, streaks, mascots, reward loops.
Don't adopt corporate bank aesthetics — dense institutional tables, navy/gold palettes.
Don't use neon fintech styling — dark mode with electric accents, glassmorphism cards.
Don't spread peach as a background wash, gradient fill, or page tint.
Don't add side-stripe borders on cards, list items, or alerts.
Don't use gradient text for headings or amounts.
Don't nest cards inside cards — use Glass List rows instead.
Don't import custom display fonts or use fluid clamp() heading scales.
Don't add decorative motion — transitions convey state only.
